description: Types shared by every core interface (spec 19.20): references, ids, the domain outcome union, the client environment, the launch and debug specs and the task meta. Referenced as loomworks.Common/1#/$defs/<Name>; mounted on no object.

Id.description: An opaque entity id (spec 19.12); stale when its session generation is not the daemon's.

Ref.description: A reference to an entity: its id (the editor, from results and views) or its key (the CLI, as the user typed it).

Environment.description: The client's environment (spec 19.15 Environment), sent as the envelope's env.

task_id.description: The task the call runs as, for a task-streamed method.

Declined.description: The daemon will not run the call; the CLI runs it in-process instead.

Confirm.description: The call needs the user's confirmation of a plan first.

Outcome.description: The domain result every operation shares (spec 19.20 'Errors and domain results'). Clients tolerate an unknown outcome.

LaunchSpec.description: A resolved launch (spec 19.15 Run): the program the client runs.

env.description: The launch's own contribution over the client's environment, never a whole environment.

DebugSpec.description: A resolved debug launch; its fields are defined with Launch/1.prepare_debug (step 5k).

TaskMeta.description: The start meta of a task frame (spec 19.15).
